notes: The original is an official anime CM; the Bilibili download account is a nonofficial mirror and is credited separately from the original publisher.
Only the seven clearly transcribed phrases are selected. An ambiguous earlier phrase transcribed as atarashii tanomi is deliberately unused instead of inventing dialogue.
All excerpts retain original speed and original anime speech; the old Rana recordings remain archived.

P includes both complete utterances from the same uninterrupted original-CM window, plus their matching video and same-scene finish frame. Faster combat release must not cut or speed up recorded media.
Shockwaves/parfait projectiles are gameplay adaptations, not claims of canonical supernatural powers.
